# setup
```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, dbplyr, here, janitor, rio, RPostgres, DBI, RIBBiTR-BII/ribbitrrr)

wddir = here(Sys.getenv("data_dir"), "bd_qpcr_results", "rz_snarl_qpcr_comparison")

dbcon = hopToDB("railway")

```

# load data
```{r load, echo=FALSE}
list.files(wddir)

snarl_raw = import(here(wddir, "qpcr_compare_data_260904.xlsx"),
                   na = c("NA", "NaN"))
rz_raw = import(here(wddir, "RIBBiTR_SierraNevadaComparision_04012026_Plate1_rerun2_Diluted_results.xlsx"),
                which = "WorkingResults")

# pointer tables
db_bd = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "bd_qpcr_results"))

rz_db = db_bd %>%
  filter(sample_name_bd %in% snarl_raw$bd_swab_id) %>%
  collect()
  
```


```{r clean, echo=FALSE}
snarl_clean = snarl_raw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  rename(extraction_lab = lab_extract,
         extraction_method = extract_method,
         qpcr_lab = lab_qpcr,
         bd_quant_cycle = quant_cycle,
         bd_start_quant = start_quant) %>%
  mutate(extraction_lab = recode_values(extraction_lab,
                                        "pitt" ~ "rz_lab",
                                        default = extraction_lab),
         collect_lab = recode_values(collect_lab,
                                     "pitt" ~ "rz_lab",
                                     default = collect_lab))

frog_lookup = snarl_clean %>%
  select(frog_num,
         bd_swab_id,
         species_capture,
         collect_lab) %>%
  distinct()

rz_clean = rz_db %>%
  rename(bd_swab_id = sample_name_bd,
         bd_quant_cycle = bd_cycle_quant,
         bd_start_quant = bd_target_quant,
         bd_load = bd_its1_copies_per_swab,
         notes = comments_qpcr) %>%
  mutate(qpcr_lab = "rz_lab",
         extraction_lab = "rz_lab",
         extraction_method = "qiagen") %>%
  left_join(frog_lookup, by = "bd_swab_id") %>%
  select(all_of(colnames(snarl_clean)))

alligned_clean = bind_rows(snarl_clean,
                           rz_clean)

```

# summary stats
```{r summary}

peace = alligned_clean %>%
  group_by(frog_num,
           species_capture) %>%
  count()
```
